urgency_policy: Priority scoring rubric used for intake: base score = revenue_impact(0-4) + sla_sensitivity(0-3) + regulatory(0-3) + irreversible_migration_window(0-2) + experiment_value(0-2) - cost_flexibility(0-2). P0 = score >= 8 and hard-SLA or revenue-critical. P1 = score 5-7 (important but can accept mitigations). P2 = score <5 (batch, low-SLA, experimental).
